Unlike IPv4
column2: in IPv6 there is no unique structure to represent the

column1: nexthop and both the route and nexthop information are squashed to the
same structure ('struct fib6_info'). In order to improve resource
utilization the driver consolidates identical nexthop groups to the same
internal representation of a nexthop group.
Therefore
column2: when the offload indication of a nexthop changes

column1: needs to iterate over all the linked fib6_info and toggle their offload
flag accordingly.
During abort
column2: all the routes are removed from the device and unlinked

column1: from their nexthop group. The offload indication is cleared just before
the group is destroyed
column2: but by that time no fib6_info is linked to the

column1: group and the offload indication remains set.
Fix this by clearing the offload indication just before dropping the
reference from the nexthop.
